en: "Dummy. It's you alone against all of us."{w}
note: Answers Montana's 'we outnumber you' (SCD14:2802, slice 060).

en: "Heyyyy!?{w}W-well, my opponents are old folks, and if it's one on two, I can manage somehow..."{w}
"I shall join in as well, I shall!{w}Back of the blade, back of the blade! And sometimes for real!!"{w}
note: mineuchi (striking with the blunt back of the blade) = 'back of the blade', Babis's running gag; set up so the double-edged joke in 2830 works.

en: "Like I said, you've got nothing to do with this!"{w}
"And so, c'mere, you~"{w}
"No, stop, nooooo!?"{w}
"Playtime with my grandson, after all this time, aaah!{w}Uhee, uhee-hee-hee-hee~"{w}
note: Montana is male (glossary), so 'grandson'.

en: "This'll be a treat, eh, Ubogenya!{w}Fo-fo-fo!!"{w}
"H-hewp meeee!?"{w}
note: Source slurs 'help' (tasukete -> tashukete).

en: "Come on, come on! What's this, what's that!"{w}
"Kya-kya-kya!"{w}
note: Star symbol after the laugh dropped (ASCII only, no convention for it).

en: "I feint with the back of the blade...{w}and then, back of the blade after all!"{w}
"Hngyaaaah!?"{w}
"Damn samuraiiii...!{w}A double-edged blade doesn't even HAVE a back to hit with!"{w}
note: Source: no mineuchi with a double-edged blade (no blunt back).

en: "Oh, well done, well done!{w}You've got guts!!"{w}
"You've grown up, Montana!!"{w}
"From this day forth, you too walk the way of the back of the blade!"{w}
note: Nonsense in the source too ('from today you too are mineuchi').

en: "Hah, hah...{w}Jeez, what an ordeal that was..."{w}
Montana triumphed over his ancestors!{w}

"Oh, that's right,
you'll have to do this too at least once when you die, y'hear?"{w}
"For real?"{w}
"As long as the mission isn't over, anyway.{w}Well, that'll be a long way off, I'd wager."{w}
note: The 'mission' is the important duty of Baroque Fort's ruler from slice 060 (SCD14:2788).

en: "Well then, I suppose it's time we passed on."{w}
note: Source writes 'go' with the kanji for dying (pun); rendered as 'passed on'.

en: "A thrilling ascent to heaven, so it is!!"{w}
"Take care.{w}The future is made by you, the living.{w}Don't you ever forget that."{w}
"Ah, old hag!"{w}
note: babaa is rude ('old hag'); Montana's habitual address for Ubogenya, kept at full rudeness.

en: "What is it?"{w}
"Sorry, at a time like this, but I...{w}I can eat bitter melon now!"{w}
note: bitter melon as in slices 024/025.

en: "Oh, is that so, is that so!{w}Then next, it's Gasaram greens!"{w}
note: New name: Gasaram greens (romanized vegetable name).

en: "Nah, those are..."{w}
"No being picky!{w}If you don't eat properly, I'll come back to haunt you, y'know?{w}Hmmm~?"{w}
"...S-seriously?"{w}
"Seriously."{w}
"...I shouldn't have said anything."{w}
"Ha ha ha, Montana! Give everyone my regards!"{w}
The spirits of the former rulers entrusted the future to Montana and faded away.{w}

"Well, I guess that means I finally get to be king.{w}Thanks for helping me out, everyone."{w}{p}"I'll be at my usual spot in Baroque Fort, so if you ever need advice, come by anytime!"{w}{p}"...But Gasaram greens are the one thing I can't help you with.{w}Just so you know."{w}
Montana left.{w}
Now there is no one here.{w}{p}...Or so you thought!{w}
"We came back, we did!"{w}
note: Babis speaks for all three ghosts (they return together); 'We' chosen from the next two rows.

en: "Turns out we just couldn't let go!"{w}
note: mirendaradara = dripping with lingering attachment.

en:
"Since we're here anyway,
we thought we'd stick around a little longer, eh?"{w}

"And now, the moment you've all been waiting for:
back-of-the-blade time, it is!"{w}
You sent the undead trio flying.{w}
note: Subject (the party) restored.

en: "Argh, I am defeated, I aaam!{w}Just kidding, just kidding!"{w}
"Young'uns really are strong, aren't they!"{w}
"Hee hee hee, maybe we oughta try some training too, eh!?"{w}
Suddenly, a voice echoed in the darkness.{w}
Voice
"Do not look.{w}Do not touch.{w}Do not become involved."{w}
And then, your bodies were hurled out of the room.{w}
"Come as two."{w}
note: 2-nin de maire: likely an entry condition (a party of exactly two). Kept terse and literal.

en: In the darkness was a grotesque monster.{w}{p}The monster was bound in chains, but the chains had rusted until they were mere ornaments.{w}

Why does it look like this?{w}Why is it in chains?{w}Why is it in a place like this?{w}{p}All of it was a mystery, but judging by the fist raised to strike at you this very moment,{w}{p}it seems fair to say that he (or she) is, at the very least, not a welcome presence for you, wouldn't you agree?{w}
note: 'he (or she)' is in the source (the gender joke is the narrator's own).

en: The grotesque monster sank into the darkness, along with its many mysteries.{w}
There is a strange altar.{w}
Perhaps some kind of qualification is needed to make it work?{w}In the end, nothing happened.{w}
There are Unicorns here.{w}The Unicorns seem to welcome your visit.{w}
note: Plural: 3042 says 'one of the Unicorns'.

en: You passed on the words of the adventurer waiting below to the Unicorns, and offered them the Great Tree Staff.{w}
After a while, one of the Unicorns stepped forward and took the Great Tree Staff in its mouth.{w}{p}Was that the Unicorn that saved her?{w}
note: 'her' = the adventurer of 47001; the narration calls her kanojo (3065, 3068, 3071).

en: An adventurer called out to you.{w}
"I'm sorry to bother you out of nowhere.{w}I'm in some trouble... Would you please be willing to help me...?"{w}
Will you help?

"I used to be an alchemist, but...{w}I got lost here in the Churos Highlands."{w}{p}"I was out of items and spells, and ready to die, but by sheer luck, I was saved by a Unicorn living on the plateau to the south of here."{w}{p}"It lent me this Great Tree Staff, and saw me safely back to town."{w}{p}"After that, I gained some experience, and grew into an adventurer myself."{w}{p}"I came here to return the Great Tree Staff along with my thanks for that time, but...{w}...no matter what I do, it won't see me."{w}{p}"In the southern lands, there's an altar that guides you to the spring where the Unicorns live, but whatever is wrong with me, it won't guide me."{w}{p}"At the very least, I want to entrust this Great Tree Staff to someone, and thank it for that time, even if only through someone else!"{w}{p}"Please, would you return this Great Tree Staff to the Unicorn, and tell it how grateful I was...?"{w}
note: Does not say why the altar refuses her; nothing added.

en: "Oh, everyone...{w}It seems your packs are full...{w}What a shame. I'll ask someone else..."{w}
"I'm sorry to ask this of you, but I'm counting on you."{w}
"...Right, of course.{w}I'm sorry. I'll ask someone else..."{w}
"Please, return the Great Tree Staff to the Unicorn...{w}And tell it how grateful I was..."{w}
"You were able to meet the Unicorn!{w}And you returned the Great Tree Staff for me...{w}Thank you so much."{w}
"I wanted to see it, even just one more time...{w}No, no, I mustn't wish for more than this."{w}{p}"Thank you for everything.{w}I pray your adventures are blessed with good fortune.{w}Farewell..."{w}
Just as she was about to leave, a single Unicorn appeared from deep in the forest, atop the plateau far in the distance.{w}
She and the Unicorn quietly gazed at each other.{w}It was the final farewell between two who could never touch.{w}
"Unicorn...!{w}Thank you so much for that time!!{w}I'll treasure the life you saved...!!"{w}
As she waved, the Unicorn gave a single cry and vanished into the depths of the forest.{w}
"I got to see it one last time...{w}I'm so glad... So truly glad...{w}Everyone, thank you so much."{w}
The adventurer bowed deeply toward the highlands where the Unicorns live, and left.{w}
There is a signpost, damp and glistening with moisture.{w}

note: Sign box: full-width spacing rebuilt in ASCII, three equal-width lines. New names: Purification Falls, Silent Forest (the Silent Beast's forest, 48002).

en: Suddenly, a beast appeared before you without a sound.{w}{p}'Without a sound' is no figure of speech: your ears truly cannot hear even the rustle of the grass its claws part.{w}
